name: Andarium
subtitle: 在 iOS 上原生运行真实 Linux 内核
description:
在 iPhone / iPad 上原生运行真实 Linux 内核的实验性项目，可在设备上启动 Guest 系统。
需要 iOS 27 及以上；安装包较大（约 1 GB）。

versions.localizedDescription:
Release IPA
The IPA must be sideloaded with Increased Memory Limit and Extended Virtual Addressing entitlements. It also supports experimental JIT via StikDebug.

Prebuilt artifacts
• android-6.18-…-vd2.tar.gz: the accepted Android kernel bundle. Extract it into .build/kernel/artifacts/.
• lineage24-…-r28.tar.gz: the accepted Android system release. Extract it anywhere, then run android/lineage-24/tools/install-release.py --source /lineage24-mainline6.18-4k-20261115-los24-r28.
